# Borealis release decision

The Borealis cooling rollout is approved for a 10% pilot after the latency audit.
Do not expand the rollout until the 24-hour acceptance window completes.

| Measure | Acceptance threshold |
| --- | --- |
| Median latency | 42 ms or less |
| p95 latency | 80 ms or less |
| Minimum audit sample | 1,200 requests |

The audit is evidence, not authorization to change the rollout automatically.
Review the maintained acceptance checklist before approving the next phase.
